# Semester HQ

> Semester HQ is an all-in-one academic planner for college students. It combines a calendar, assignment and to-do tracking, GPA calculation, note-taking, a study timer, an exam countdown tracker, a project hub, flashcards, and study groups into one connected app — replacing the separate tools (LMS, calendar app, group chat, notes app) students normally juggle each semester.

## Product

- Free to use forever, fully in the browser, no account or card required, on one device.
- Semester HQ Plus is $7.99/month, billed monthly, cancel anytime, and unlocks signing in, cross-device sync, AI syllabus upload, and study groups.
- Group/university pricing is available for departments, clubs, or student organizations — contact hello@semesterhq.com.
- AI syllabus upload: drop in a PDF, photo, or pasted text of a syllabus and the app automatically fills in the course, schedule, assignments, and exam dates — fully editable afterward.
- Live app (also usable directly, no marketing site required): https://nyfi444.github.io/student-dashboard/

## Features

- Calendar with month, week, day, and year views
- Assignments and to-do list synced to the calendar
- Grades and GPA, recalculated live as scores are logged, weighted by each course's real grading breakdown
- Notebook with rich-text formatting, highlights, checklists, and folder-level sharing
- Study timer with per-course, per-week tracking
- Exam tracker with live countdowns
- Project hub for breaking large projects into milestones and tasks
- Flashcard decks organized by course
- Study groups: share notes and tasks with classmates via a join code, with a shared roster and activity feed
- Dark mode with a per-color tint, and per-class color coding throughout

## Privacy

- Local-only usage never leaves the browser; no account required.
- If signed in, planner data syncs to a database tied to the account.
- Documents uploaded for AI parsing are sent to Anthropic's Claude API to extract structured data and are not retained afterward or used for model training.
- No data is sold, and no third-party ad trackers run inside the app.
- Full policy: https://nyfi444.github.io/Semester-HQ-Site/privacy.html
